description: Seznam energetických specialistů is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu. A list of energy specialists categorized by city of operation and type of license. Coverage: Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu. The portal shows the English title as "List of Energy Specialists" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu. Its keywords include energetický specialista, Ministerstvo průmyslu a obchodu, energy specialists, Energy Management Act, Ministry of Industry and Trade, Zákon o hospodaření energií. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/47609109/1771101940/distribuce/53f4b322415aa38a5eb43fefe476a1a6/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
